summary: Product designer with 8 years across B2B SaaS and fintech. I take messy workflows from research to shipped, measured design, and I work closely with engineers from the first sketch.

bullets: Led redesign of the merchant onboarding flow across 4 squads; completion rate rose from 58% to 74% within two quarters.
Built a design system of 60 components in Figma with engineering, cutting average UI build time per feature by about 30%.
Ran 25 moderated usability sessions and turned findings into a prioritised roadmap adopted by the product leadership team.
Managed 2 designers, setting quarterly goals and weekly critique routines.
Designed the reporting module for an analytics product used by 3,200 accounts; support tickets about reports fell by 35%.
Introduced a research repository and monthly customer interviews, informing 6 roadmap changes.
Partnered with 2 engineering teams to ship accessibility fixes bringing the app to WCAG 2.1 AA on core flows.
Shipped the rider app booking redesign, increasing completed bookings by 12% in the first month.
Created prototypes in Figma and Principle for 9 experiments, 4 of which moved to production.
Delivered websites and mobile prototypes for 15 small-business clients from discovery to handoff.
Facilitated 10 stakeholder workshops to agree scope and priorities.

projects.description: Wrote a one-page contrast and keyboard checklist for designers, shared with a community of about 800 members.
